decisions.reason: As a low-risk finish extension that remained visible and was upgraded to its own page after launch, it likely meets aspiration levels sufficiently and is cheap enough to carry within normal organisational slack.
Its continued standalone presentation across 2023 and 2024 suggests results at or above aspiration for a strategically relevant drainage innovation, so management would retain it.

Because it is a very recent pump-drain launch in a category where an earlier variant was already withdrawn, management would see elevated shortfall risk but still keep it one more year to learn whether the revised concept can reach aspiration.
